 <section id="ce772e70" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="5b549fea" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="55adca0d" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="d4641346" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="9ce04717" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1542322223"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1542322223" data-ai-tag="Section title" style=""> <h2 class="m-text-align-center text-align-center size-28 t-size-24 m-size-22"><span style="display: unset;" class="font-size-28 t-font-size-24 m-font-size-22">What&acute;s Included in the Camp:</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="widget_42u" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="4229182353"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="4229182353" style=""> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li><span style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">6 days of guided kitesurfing (unlimited, depending on wind &amp; energy)</span> 
</span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">7 nights accommodation in the kite house in Tarifa Old Town (single or double/twin rooms &mdash; no dorms)</span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">Healthy self-service breakfasts and packed-lunches</span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">Daily guidance/coaching and video analysis to support your progression</span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">Evening social events: tapas night, rooftop paella / barbecue (or similar) giving you a chance to relax, share stories, and meet fellow kiters</span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">A great range of no-wind activities and excursions</span></li></ul> 
<p class="text-align-left m-text-align-center"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div>

 <div data-layout-section="" data-auto="flex-section" id="1587357752" data-flex-id="e3a1f0e0" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1410834944"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1912160310"></div> 
 <section id="fcc144aa" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="0c7d7fbd" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="a9e71adc" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="34c4b0be" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="3eb4a16c" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1419592844"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1419592844" style="" data-ai-tag="Section short title"> <h2 class="m-text-align-left"><span style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">Are these camps for you?</span></h2> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="e90f2dea" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="f14c70eb" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1829331628"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1829331628" style="" data-ai-tag="Short description"><p class="text-align-left m-text-align-left"><span style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">If you recognise some of the following points, then YES these camps are just what you&acute;re looking for!</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section> 
</div> 
 <div data-layout-section="" data-auto="flex-section" id="1072867693" data-flex-id="b97e7470" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1410834944"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1062287903"></div> 
 <section id="4445da24" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="f2d95112" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="248369a4" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="a4904898" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="8caa388a" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="5920bfea" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="image" data-external-id="1858365253"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1858365253" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1858365253"><img src="https://le-de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/opt/P1060656-1920w.JPG" alt="" id="1912679314" class="" width="1920" height="1440" data-dm-image-path="https://de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/P1060656.JPG" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
</div> 
 <div id="47a9240a" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1395827582"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1395827582" style="" data-ai-tag="Short title 1"> <h3 class="m-size-19 t-size-20 size-24" style=""><span class="m-font-size-19 t-font-size-20 font-size-24" style="color: var(--color_1); display: unset;">You&acute;re already a kiter</span><span class="m-font-size-19 t-font-size-20 font-size-24" style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><br/></span></h3> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="5d51a83c" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1235247319"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1235247319" style="" data-ai-tag="Short description 1"><p class="m-text-align-left text-align-left"><strong style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">Q: Who are these camps for?</strong><span style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;"><br/>The camps are designed for kiteboarders who have been riding for at least a year, are comfortable riding upwind, and have experience in a variety of conditions. They are not for absolute beginners. If your skill level doesn&rsquo;t match the group, private lessons will be suggested instead.</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="b853b243" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="f7f2dc01" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="a0d159fa" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="image" data-external-id="1127747919"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1127747919" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1127747919"><img src="https://le-de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/opt/Alexei+Morocco-1920w.JPG" alt="" id="1480132994" class="" width="1920" height="1440" data-dm-image-path="https://de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/Alexei+Morocco.JPG" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
</div> 
 <div id="69128393" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1136914064"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1136914064" style="" data-ai-tag="Short title 2"> <h3 class="t-size-20 size-24" style="line-height: 28px;"><span class="font-size-24" style="display: initial; color: var(--color_1);">Not really progressing?</span></h3> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="b3d6f473" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1697922668"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1697922668" style="" data-ai-tag="Short description 2"><p class="m-text-align-left text-align-left"><span style="color: var(--color_1); display: initial;">So you ride ok, and can hold your own in varied conditions but you&acute;re struggling to break out and start doing the cool stuff you see other people doing? We&acute;ve all been there, and at this stage a kitesurf camp with dedicated coaching and loads of general advice (and the encouragement of your new buddies on the camp) is just what you need!</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="9c23d154" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="d9b340df" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="4c126f79" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="image" data-external-id="1953652874"> <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1953652874" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1953652874"><img src="https://le-de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/opt/Dakhla+boys-1920w.png" alt="" id="1161742875" class="" width="762" height="732" data-dm-image-path="https://de.cdn-website.com/4dff6c3a885c43daaa7b1b9e6445a736/dms3rep/multi/Dakhla+boys.png" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
</div> 
 <div id="0e740b08" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1536597210"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1536597210" style="" data-ai-tag="Short title 3"> <h3 class="m-size-19 t-size-20 size-24"><span class="m-font-size-19 t-font-size-20 font-size-24" style="color: var(--color_1); display: unset;">Why kite on your own?</span></h3> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="fc70c0db" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1527160226"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1527160226" style="" data-ai-tag="Short description 3"><p style="direction: ltr; letter-spacing: 0em; line-height: 1.8em;"><span style="color: var(--color_1); display: unset;">When you join one of our Kiter&acute;s Camps, not only will you be receiving coaching from Kevin - one of Tarifa&acute;s most experienced instructors, you will also be riding with other like-minded kiters. More fun than a holiday on your own, right?!</span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section> 
</div> 
 <div data-auto="flex-section" id="1190794571" data-flex-id="07ca3145" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1786681875"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1523687461"></div> 
 <section id="b4baab93" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="f1503aaf" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid="" data-binding="{"bindingName":"background","value":"dynamic_page_collection.image"}"> <div id="2221af24" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="47aab009" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="1cce9184" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="spacer" data-external-id="1491103886"> <div data-element-type="spacer" class="dmSpacer" id="1491103886"></div> 
</div> 
 <div id="widget_dbj" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="412275290"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="412275290" style=""> <h3 class="size-24 t-size-20 m-size-19"><span style="display: unset;" class="font-size-24 t-font-size-20 m-font-size-19">Tarifa: The Ultimate Destination</span></h3> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section> 
</div> 
 <div data-auto="flex-section" id="1016144187" data-flex-id="940a79c6" data-layout-section="" data-page-element-type="section" data-page-element-id="1786681875"> <div class="flex-widgets-container" id="1973177585"></div> 
 <section id="f392a627" class="flex-element section" data-auto="flex-element-section"> <div id="59a1f035" class="flex-element grid" data-auto="flex-element-grid" data-layout-grid=""> <div id="b718171e" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="80d323cb" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="f89b925b" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1826536789"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1826536789" style="" data-ai-tag="Short paragraph"> <ul class="defaultList custom-list-6"><li><span style="display: unset;">Tarifa&rsquo;s unique combination of predictable wind, diverse spots, and beautiful beaches makes it one of Europe&rsquo;s top kite destinations. With different wind strengths and sea conditions, meaning that Tarifa makes complete kiters!</span></li></ul> 
<p><span style="display: unset;"><span class="ql-cursor">﻿</span></span></p> <ul class="defaultList custom-list-6"><li><span style="display: unset;">Staying in the historic Old Town puts you close to the beaches &mdash; and immersed in Andalucian charm, local culture, vibrant nightlife and delicious food. It&rsquo;s a vacation for your senses as well as your kite skills.</span></li></ul> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div id="1f1e41fb" class="flex-element group" data-auto="flex-element-group"> <div id="48bca755" class="flex-element widget-wrapper" data-auto="flex-element-widget-wrapper" data-widget-type="paragraph" data-external-id="1216145141"> <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1216145141" style="" data-ai-tag="Short paragraph"> <ul class="defaultList custom-list-6"><li><span style="display: initial;">If the wind doesn&rsquo;t show up &mdash; it&rsquo;s not a problem. The surrounding region is packed with incredible alternatives: We can explore historic cities, scenic villages, beautiful coastal rides, and Andalucian culture that&rsquo;s waiting to be discovered.</span></li></ul> 
<p><span style="display: initial;"><span class="ql-cursor">﻿</span></span></p> <ul class="defaultList custom-list-6"><li><span style="display: initial;">For a mature kiter who wants both adventure and experiences &mdash; Tarifa strikes the perfect balance. Great kiting, great ambience, great memories.</span></li></ul> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</section>
